relations.text: ASCENIV用のRSV血漿を年3.5万リットル以上供給(2039年9月までの契約)
relations.text_en: Supplies at least 35,000 liters of RSV plasma a year for ASCENIV (agreement to September 2039)

source.label: ADMA Biologics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Pursuant to the A&R Grifols Agreement, Grifols supplies, on a non-exclusive basis, to ADMA BioManufacturing a minimum of 35,000 liters of RSV plasma annually to be used in the manufacture of ASCENIV, with an escalating price per liter depending on the volume supplied in a given 12-month period, with a minimum annual price increase every 12 months.

relations.text: 2社合計で売上の約73%を占める主要顧客の一社(2025年)
relations.text_en: One of two customers making up about 73% of revenue (2025)

source.label: ADMA Biologics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, two customers, BioCare, Inc. ("BioCare") and Priority Healthcare Distribution, Inc. ("CuraScript"), represented an aggregate of approximately 73% of our consolidated revenues.
